[general] Apple’s Camera Indicator Lights
item.description: <p>A <a href="https://daringfireball.net/2026/03/apple_enclaves_neo_camera_indicator">thoughtful review</a> of Apple&#8217;s system to alert users that the camera is on. It&#8217;s really well-designed, and important in a world where malware could surreptitiously start recording.</p> <blockquote><p>The reason it&#8217;s tempting to think that a dedicated camera indicator light is more secure than an on-display indicator is the fact that hardware is generally more secure than software, because it&#8217;s harder to tamper with. With hardware, a dedicated hardware indicator light can be connected to the camera hardware such that if the camera is accessed, the light must turn on, with no way for software running on the device, no matter its privileges, to change that. With an indicator light that is rendered on the display, it&#8217;s not foolish to worry that malicious software, with sufficient privileges, could draw over the pixels on the display where the camera indicator is rendered, disguising that the camera is in use...</p></blockquote>

item.title: [general] As the US Midterms Approach, AI Is Going to Emerge as a Key Issue Concerning Voters
item.description: <p>In December, the Trump administration signed an executive order that <a href="https://www.nytimes.com/2025/12/11/technology/ai-trump-executive-order.html">neutered</a> states&#8217; ability to regulate AI by ordering his administration to both sue and withhold funds from states that try to do so. This action pointedly supported <a href="https://www.nytimes.com/2025/12/08/us/politics/trump-executive-order-ai-laws.html">industry lobbyists</a> keen to avoid any constraints and consequences on their deployment of AI, while undermining the efforts of consumers, advocates, and industry associations concerned about AI&#8217;s harms who have spent years pushing for state regulation.</p> <p>Trump&#8217;s actions have clarified the ideological alignments around AI within America&#8217;s electoral factions. They set down lines on a new playing field for the midterm elections, prompting members of his party, the opposition, and all of us to consider where we stand in the debate over how and where to let AI transform our lives...</p>
